Wanted: F&B Server and sustainable star! At Hyatt Regency Amsterdam, green is more than just a color, it's our commitment. Situated near the lush Oosterpark and Hortus Botanicus, one of the world's oldest botanical gardens. We bring the beauty of the great outdoors inside, creating an award-winning living interior.  Mama Makan: the taste of Indonesia The vibrant Plantage neighborhood has a rich Indonesian history, trading in exotic spices in days gone by. Therefore, it's no surprise that one of the most authentic Indonesian restaurants is part of the Hyatt Regency experience. Mama Makan seamlessly blends in with the hotel lobby, connecting guests to a very special experience. Guests can savor the flavors of Indonesia while learning from our Indonesian team about the spices and stories behind each dish, creating a truly unique journey. You haven't really had a “rijstafel” until you've eaten at Mama Makan! Your role at the Regency ·        Approaching every F&B task as if you're doing it for someone special. ·        Always welcoming guests with a warm and friendly smile. Your hospitality can brighten their day.·        Offering sincere assistance to co-workers and guests whenever necessary.·        In the event of accidents or injuries to guests, responding promptly and alerting your supervisor immediately.·        Addressing guest complaints and issues with empathy, aiming for resolution and satisfaction by informing your supervisor.   Your experience ·        Prior experience in F&B is great!·        Good English language skills are important, even better if you also speak Dutch.·        We highly value reliability and responsibility - if you're someone who doesn't shy away from their duties, you're exactly who we're looking for.·        You must be eligible to work in the Netherlands, either holding an EU/EEA passport or a valid work permit for the country.

- You speak Dutch or English
- You can handle physical work
- You’re available to work at least one Saturday every four weeks
- You choose either a 2- or 3-shift system
